svg.title: Fabrication-oriented 14-inch tubular daylight collector dome drawing
svg.desc: Three-sheet preliminary engineering drawing covering dome and mold geometry, optical prism and CPC details, bill of materials, flange sealing, and fabrication sequence.
svg.text: 14-INCH DAYLIGHT COLLECTOR — DOME & FORMING TOOL GEOMETRY
PRELIMINARY DESIGN · ALL DIMENSIONS mm · DO NOT FABRICATE UNTIL OPTICAL, STRUCTURAL, WEATHER AND CODE VALIDATION IS COMPLETE
A1 — Finished dome section and controlling dimensions
UV hard coat; Ra ≤0.05 μm target
BASE BLEND: R12 OUTSIDE / R8 INSIDE
Profile ±1.0 · concentricity to flange Ø0.5 · trim flatness 0.8 max
A2 — CAD/profile coordinates and male forming plug
Inner coordinates are a true 4.0 normal offset from the outer ellipse.
Machine oversize by supplier-confirmed shrink; 0.6% is only a prototype start.
OPTICAL COLLECTOR — ORIENTATION, PRISM INSERT & CPC REFLECTOR
PRISM GEOMETRY IS A RAY-TRACE STARTING POINT, NOT A RELEASED OPTICAL PRESCRIPTION
B1 — Plan orientation and fastener pattern
Flange Ø460 · dome base Ø420 · aperture Ø356
Clamp ring: 16 × Ø5.5 on PCD Ø430
*Face toward equator: true south in Southern Hemisphere.
Prism insert and CPC redirect low rays without a sharp focal point.
B3 — Prism section and CPC developed blank
Facet A=35° · Facet B=55° · base film 1.0 optical PC/PMMA
Grooves run on dome meridians; smooth face toward incoming light.
Forms Ø404 top / Ø356 bottom / H90; reflective face inward.
PARTS, SEALING DETAIL & PROTOTYPE FABRICATION SEQUENCE
USE A CERTIFIED SKYLIGHT/ROOFING ENGINEER FOR WIND, SNOW, IMPACT, FIRE, FLASHING AND WATER-PENETRATION REQUIREMENTS

g.text: 06 · 16× M5×20 A4-70 screws, bonded washers, stop sleeves and locknuts

svg.text: C3 — Weather seal and thermal-expansion detail

g.text: Dome hole Ø7.0; clamp-ring hole Ø5.5
Initial torque 1.5–2.0 N·m; verify after thermal cycle
1 · Machine/polish male plug from profile table
2 · Predry PC per grade; start 120°C, 2–3 h
4 · Cool on tool; trim; drill oversize holes
5 · Fit prism, CPC, gasket and clamp ring
6 · Leak, impact, load, thermal and ray tests

svg.text: Never flame-polish PC; avoid incompatible solvent adhesives.
DESIGN BASIS: nominal 356 mm tube; northern-hemisphere orientation shown. Match materials and processing to the selected grade, latitude, roof pitch, climate loads and applicable skylight standards.
